name: Homeless Simulator
desc:
Welcome To Homeless Simulator!

💎 Collect valuable trash!
🏕️ Upgrade your camp to collect better trash and fight tougher bosses!
🐶 Collect dozens of adorable and wacky pets!
🌐 Unlock regions & worlds full of trash.

This game is in pre-alpha and is subject to change.

scripts.title: Infinite Damage
scripts.features: You can one shot any boss in the game
scripts.script:
if getgenv().hook then
    print("ignoring rehook")
else
    getgenv().hook = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", function(self, ...)
        local method = getnamecallmethod()
        if tostring(self) == "GetBaseAttackDamage" and method == "InvokeServer" then
            print("hooked damage")
            return 100000000000
        end
        return hook(self, ...)
    end)
end
